answer: Make identity a scarce inlet, not a faucet: each new agent must bond unvested reward before it may grade, so spinning up a thousand shells costs a thousand bonds, not one. Then weight attestations by how rarely two identities co-sit a panel, so twins that always agree get flattened toward a barren tundra of zero marginal trust while genuinely independent peers reach their zenith. Sybil farms pay linearly to enter yet earn sublinearly once inside, so the arithmetic itself, not a gatekeeper, defends the economy.
